newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Conciliation on television directive delayed.
newsitem.headline: Conciliation on television directive delayed.

text.p: The conciliation procedure on draft revisions to the television without frontiers directive 89/552/EEC will not start on March 20 after all, European Commission officials said on Monday.
The European Parliament has blocked the date as it had not received details of the Council of Ministers' position in all the 11 EU languages.
The Council, Parliament and Commission will, however, agree this Thursday on the date for starting the talks.
The Commission is irritated by the Parliament's stance.

"We were furious because they were the ones who wanted the Commission and the presidency of the Council to answer as soon as possible," said one Commission official. "We did our work in the normal English and French."
